The team were led by seventh-year head coach [[Nick McDevitt]] and played their home games at [[Murphy Center]] in [[Murfreesboro, Tennessee]] as members of [[Conference USA]] (C-USA). == Previous season == The [[2023–24 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team|Blue Raiders]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 14–19, 7–9 in C-USA play to finish in a four-way tie for fourth place. As a No. 7 seed in the [[2024 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]], they defeated [[2023–24 Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball team|Louisiana Tech]] in quarterfinals before losing to [[2023–24 Western Kentucky Hilltoppers basketball team|Western Kentucky]] in the semifinals. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
